preconditions.description: The number of registration requests is between 1 and 100,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= len(name) <= 32 for name in requests)
preconditions.description: Each name in the requests has a length between 1 and 32 characters.
All characters in each name are lowercase Latin letters.

postconditions.description: The number of responses matches the number of requests.

postconditions.expression: all(response == 'OK' or (response.startswith(request) and response[len(request):].isdigit()) for response, request in zip(responses, requests))
postconditions.description: Each response is either 'OK' or a new name formed by appending the smallest unused number to the original name.

postconditions.expression: all(response not in seen_names for response in responses)
postconditions.description: Each response name is unique and not already in the database.
